title: VC-OPD: Learning to See What Matters via Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual On-Policy Distillation (OPD) commonly uses cropped or zoomed-in image regions as teacher-side privileged information to improve fine-grained perception in small Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, local pixel-level cues are insufficient for complex visual reasoning that requires global structure, spatial relationships, and high-level semantics. We propose Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation (VC-OPD), which extends teacher-side privileged information beyond local image regions to question-conditioned visual cues. Advanced MLLMs generate cues capturing key visual details, structural relationships, and semantic evidence needed to answer each question. A multi-stage quality filtering process selects reliable cues, which are provided only to the teacher during training. This enables informative token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, helping the student learn to identify and reason over critical

translated_title: VC-OPD：通过视觉线索在线策略自蒸馏学习关注重要内容
translated_abstract: 视觉在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通常使用裁剪或放大的图像区域作为教师端的特权信息，以提升小型多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的细粒度感知能力。然而，局部像素级线索对于需要全局结构、空间关系和高级语义的复杂视觉推理是不够的。我们提出视觉线索在线策略自蒸馏（VC-OPD），将教师端特权信息从局部图像区域扩展到问题条件化的视觉线索。先进的多模态大语言模型生成捕捉关键视觉细节、结构关系以及回答每个问题所需语义证据的线索。多阶段质量过滤流程筛选出可靠的线索，这些线索仅在训练期间提供给教师。这使得在学生生成的轨迹上能够进行信息丰富的token级监督，帮助学生学会识别并对关键内容进行推理。
tldr: 该论文提出VC-OPD方法，将教师端特权信息从局部图像区域扩展为问题条件化的视觉线索，通过多阶段质量过滤与token级监督，显著提升小型多模态大语言模型在复杂视觉推理任务中的能力。
en_tdlr: VC-OPD extends teacher-side privileged information from local image regions to question-conditioned visual cues, leveraging multi-stage quality filtering and token-level supervision to improve complex visual reasoning in small multimodal large language models.
